elements_selected.content: Mini-graph widget in base.html:341-357 is `position:fixed; right:16px; bottom:16px; width:400px; height:320px` and is open by default, permanently occluding the last chips of the transclusion-panel and (on help page) body prose. Widget already has a `.zetl-graph-widget__toggle` (base.html:595) and close `×` (base.html:560-563) but no collapsed-default state. Default the widget to collapsed (toggle reveals it); persist last-state in localStorage so returning readers aren't re-prompted.
